name: B10-0520/2025 (S&D) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Tunisia to release lawyer and media commentator Sonia Dahmani, who is in prison for speaking out. It also asks Tunisia to drop the charges against her sister, free everyone jailed only for using their rights, and repeal the cybercrime law used against them. Finally, it asks European Union leaders to raise these concerns directly with Tunisia.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is a request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Sonia Dahmani, her sister, and other jailed critics in Tunisia.
- **What happens next:** European Union officials are urged to press Tunisia for their release.
